# Factor module vs Stockfish 11 `eval` trace

Generated by `tests/helpers/factors/sf11_compare.py report`; do not edit by hand.

The guide documents the Stockfish 12-era classical evaluation, so it differs from
Stockfish 11 by design. Values are net (White minus Black) internal units:
Stockfish 11 trace pawns x 213, guide units as computed.
Tolerance: 50 units per group and phase (about 0.25 pawn).

Positions compared: 232; skipped: 92.

## Causes

| Code | Cause |
|---|---|
| `material_pawn_value` | Pawn value is S(128, 213) in SF11 and S(124, 206) in the guide; some pawn piece-square entries changed. Piece values, piece PSQT and imbalance tables are equal. |
| `pawns_new_terms` | The guide adds Doubled isolated S(11, 56) and Blocked pawns on ranks 5-6; the other pawn weights are equal to SF11. |
| `pieces_rules` | Piece terms differ: knight outpost S(56, 36) vs 2 x S(30, 21), reachable outpost S(31, 22) vs S(32, 10), new edge-knight outpost S(-7, 36), King protector S(8 or 6, 9) vs S(7, 8), Bishop pawns scale (blocked + undefended) vs (1 + blocked), Rook on file S(19, 7)/S(48, 29) vs S(21, 4)/S(47, 25), Rook on queen file S(6, 11) vs S(7, 6), Trapped rook S(55, 13) vs S(52, 10), Weak queen S(56, 15) vs S(49, 15); Bishop xray pawns, Rook/Bishop on king ring and Queen infiltration exist only in the guide. |
| `mobility_tables` | Mobility bonus tables differ for knights (end game), rooks and queens; the guide also excludes squares of the own queen from knight and bishop mobility. |
| `threat_tables` | Threat by minor and by rook tables were retuned (for example rook on queen S(58, 41) vs S(51, 38)); Weak queen protection S(14, 0) exists only in the guide. |
| `threat_queen_imbalance` | The guide doubles Slider on queen and Knight on queen when the attacking side has no queen; SF11 counts them once. |
| `passed_rules` | Passed pawns: the guide scores candidate and leverable passers with its own block and king-proximity rules; PassedRank and PassedFile are equal to SF11. |
| `space_weight` | Space weight is (own pieces - 1)^2 / 16 in SF11 and (own pieces - 3 + min(blocked pawns, 9))^2 / 16 in the guide. |
| `king_safe_check_count` | SF11 adds a fixed weight per check type that has a safe check (Queen 780, Rook 1080, Bishop 635, Knight 790); the guide multiplies its weight by the number of safe checks, capped at 1.45-1.75. King danger enters as danger^2 / 4096, so the gap grows quickly. |
| `king_no_own_pawns` | King pawn distance: with no own pawns SF11 uses distance 0 and the guide 6 (16 units per step in the end game); the guide also caps the distance at 6. |
| `king_blocked_storm` | Blocked storm: SF11 subtracts S(82, 82) only for an enemy pawn on the third rank; the guide uses per-rank tables (end game 78, 15, 10, 6, 2 for ranks 3-7). |
| `king_shelter_rules` | Shelter rules: the guide ignores own shelter pawns attacked by an enemy pawn and uses a per-rank blocked-storm table; SF11 counts every own pawn and subtracts S(82, 82) only for a blocked pawn on the third rank. The shelter enters the score and, as 6 x shelter / 8, the king danger. |
| `king_danger_mobility` | The mobility difference (Mobility row) enters king danger with weight 1, and danger^2 / 4096 amplifies it. |
| `winnable_weights` | SF11 Initiative vs guide Winnable: pawns 11 vs 12, infiltration 12 vs 24, constant -100 vs -110, and SF11's almost-unwinnable test also needs no passed pawns. |
| `winnable_sign` | The correction takes the sign of the score before it; that score has the opposite sign in the two engines, so the corrections point in opposite directions. |
